security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*; frame-src *

bundle.shortDescription: Launch multiple AI coding agents with split terminals
bundle.longDescription: Agent Launcher runs several AI coding agents (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, Grok) side by side as live terminals, with a localhost control API so an agent can spawn and drive its own team.
